integrity: A complete self-contained proof is supplied. An independent enumeration implementation was run for finite sizes; these computations do not replace the general proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the minimum weight and all attaining labelled configurations for Cartesian products of two complete graphs; it does not give the full weight polynomial, non-minimum counts, or arbitrary Cartesian products. Bibliographic priority is not independently certified.
title: Minimum Italian domination on rook graphs: exact optimizers and a sharp transition
